assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original production background for a Chinese Poyang Lake ecology card game. No UI, no text, no labels, no border, no logos, no watermarks. Original scenery, do not copy any existing game map.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production illustration atlas for an original Poyang Lake ecology card game. Keep subject recognizable at tiny card size. Each panel is its own self-contained landscape illustration with a clearly centered subject, no text, no lettering, no UI, no border, no logo. Original art.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent sprite atlas for an original cozy 16-bit Chinese wetland ecology game. Row 2 left to right: clump of 10 golden reed stalks with green leaves; small rectangular wooden floating ecological raft with lush green plants on top; single small white Jiangxi village cottage with dark gray tiled sloped roof and warm yellow window; small wooden fishing boat with straw canopy. High craft pixel sprites not photorealistic, no antialiased painterly edges, exact regular 4x2 atlas, transparent background, no text no labels no grids no frames no watermark. Original designs.
